full_judgment: Plaintiff filed a suit for declaration of title in the court of Assistant Judge in charge, Parshuram, District-Feni in the land in question described in the schedule of the plaint. The suit land originally belonged to Ex-Zaminder, Maharaza, Tripura where one Durga got it as tenant by way of settlement and was inducted into the possession. Thereafter Durga died leaving behind Raj Kumari Benoda Sundari Devi and 4 others where one Abdul Mojid Exectited a Kabuliyat in favour of the owner in order to get it by way of settlement and ultimately such Kabuliat was accepted on receipt of rent from him. In turn death also took Abdul Mojid who left behind only daughter Hasina and brother's son Janu Mia as legal heirs. While they were in peaceful possession one Abdul Ariz the predecessor of the plaintiff; purchased the some on 5.5.1923 and acquired good title there. Then Abdul Aziz also died leaving behind only son Muslim Mia, the predecessor of the plaintiff, who ultimately inherited such property; yet the S.A. record has been erroneously published in the name of the government for which the plaintiff filed a suit for declaration of title since he is in exclusive possession of the property in question.
